description: Every paper of the offline library outside the arXiv supplement: the Awesome-LLM-Compression catalogue's retrieved papers and the curated references. Each is a library path and the URL of its publisher's PDF (arXiv at a fixed version, OpenReview, PMLR, ACL Anthology, conference proceedings); compression_bench/scripts/deploy/prepare_references.py downloads them and makes each text extract (`.txt` beside the PDF) with pdftotext -layout -enc UTF-8.
